# Day Review

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A structured retrospective evaluating a completed day.

## Scope note

- Output of the Morning Review workflow: assesses the prior day against the Day Plan.
- Includes Plus-Minus-Next (PMN) analysis: what worked, what needs improving, and what's next.
